name: Neon noir
eras: c. 1980s revival onward (Michael Mann's work); term popularized 2010s
garments: not a fashion look — a cinematography style
reacts_against: classic film noir's black-and-white or desaturated palette, replacing it with the same high-contrast shadow grammar rendered in saturated neon pink and cyan.

findings: dark — about 65% of the measured color across 3 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
